history.content: i dont even know why im typing this. its dumb. money stuff i guess
It sounds like you almost deleted it as you typed, and then left it there anyway. Money stuff can carry a lot even when it feels hard to put into words.
not really pressure. more like. i had to ask my younger brother to cover my half of rent again. third month now. hes 24 and ive got my whole life supposedly figured out
Ah, I had that wrong. Maybe let’s leave pressure aside, and just stay with what this is like for you, what word feels closer?

i dont have a word. i just. i hand him the venmo request screenshot like its no big deal and then i go sit in my car. older sibling whos supposed to have it together asking the kid for money. i avoid looking at him at dinner
That has an exposed, hard-to-look-at feeling in it, more than just the money itself. I think I can see why you’d want to look away at dinner.

yeah. exposed is. close. he never makes it weird thats the worst part. he just says no worries. and i feel like im twelve. i make more than him on paper i just bury myself every month and i cant tell anyone why

Yeah, exposed is close, and the part that stings most might be that he stays kind while you still feel “twelve.” It sounds like the money is also saying something harsh about you, not just about the rent.
saying something harsh about me yeah. that im a failure basically. like the spending is proof of something rotten not just bad months. i dont know. ive never said any of this out loud
That sounds brutally self-critical, like the spending gets turned into evidence about who you are. You don’t have to pin it down further right now if you don’t want to.
yeah. evidence about who i am. thats it exactly. i should go. but thanks. didnt expect to actually say it
I’m glad you said it here, and we can leave it there now.
